description: Investor directive 2026-08-29 (recorded in CLAUDE.md ## Infra): all local apps run via Docker / Docker Compose — no code runs bare on the host. Apply to apps/chat (the only app so far): compose file to build/run the server (loopback-only exposure preserved), persistent volume or bind mount for the SQLite data dir, read access to .lattice/ for event ingestion, and a containerized path for BOTH the test suite and the agent-facing chat CLI (agents must invoke it without running node on the host — e.g. docker compose run/exec wrapper). Update apps/chat README run instructions accordingly. Constraints: official images only, no registries requiring accounts/spend, no egress beyond image pulls, do not touch existing GitHub repos or DO services. Forward-looking: this compose setup should be the template for eventual DO hosting per CLAUDE.md Infra.
title: Containerize chat app: docker compose is the only way code runs
